source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Clutch and Transmissions, p.7-17

procedures.title: Transmission side cover (Muncie 4-speed): remove, overhaul and install
parts: shifter shaft and detent plate assemblies
steps: Removal: unhook the control rods from the levers.
Put the transmission in second by moving the 1-2 (rear cover) lever to its forward detent.
Lift the cover off the case carefully and let the oil drain.
Disassembly: remove the outer lever nuts, lock washers and flat washers, and pull the levers off the shafts.
Take both forks off the shifter shaft/detent plate assemblies, then pull both shaft assemblies from the cover; pry out the cover lip seals only if damaged.
Mark the parts so they go back in the same relationship.
Remove the detent cam spring and pivot C-ring, then both detent cams.
Assembly: put the 1-2 detent cam on the pivot pin first, then the 3-4 cam, so the spring notches are offset (opposite each other) and face downward.
Fit the C-ring on the pivot shaft and hook the spring into the cam notches.
Insert both shaft assemblies without damaging the lip seals; fit the forks to the detent plates, lifting the detent cam so they seat fully.
Fit the outer levers with flat washers, lock washers and nuts.
notes: See figure 20 in the manual for the cover parts.
